name: extract_segment
description: Crop a 3D image volume to the bounding box of a target label in a mask.

parameters.name: mask_path
parameters.description: NIfTI label mask in the same voxel grid as image_path.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Voxel value identifying the structure of interest.

parameters.name: padding_voxels
parameters.description: Number of voxels of padding on each side. Defaults to 4.

fields.name: cropped_path
fields.description: Path to the cropped NIfTI written under the agent's scratch dir.

fields.name: bbox_voxels
fields.description: Bounding box as [xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax] inclusive.
